description: Structured eval definitions for the SNS Topic Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across topic types (Standard, FIFO) and prerequisite failure branches (FIFO with Lambda subscriber, AWS-managed key with cross-account, HTTP without delivery logging). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Standard topic with SSE-KMS, S3 access policy, SQS + Lambda subscriptions, filter policy, delivery logging
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — full checklist with subscriptions, filter, logging
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production SNS topic named "order-events" in us-east-1. It receives messages from S3 bucket "order-uploads" via S3 Event Notification. Two subscribers: SQS queue "order-queue" (filter on event_type=["order_created"]) and Lambda function "order-handler". Enable SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key. Enable SQS delivery status logging. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TOPIC: order-events
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Topic type — Standard (best-effort ordering, unlimited TPS)
  [✓]      Encryption — SSE-KMS (alias/aws/sns, same-account)
  [✓]      Access policy — S3 notification pattern (Principal:* + aws:SourceArn: order-uploads)
  [✓]      Subscriptions — 2 active (SQS: order-queue, Lambda: order-handler)
  [✓]      Delivery logging — SQS failure (role: SNSDeliveryFeedback)
  [✓]      Filter policy — event_type: ["order_created"] on SQS subscription
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:order-events
  aws sns list-subscriptions-by-topic --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:order-events
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:order-events --query 'Attributes.KmsMasterKeyId'

eval_cases.name: FIFO topic with Lambda subscriber — protocol not supported
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — FIFO topics only support SQS FIFO subscribers
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a FIFO SNS topic named "payment-events.fifo" in us-east-1. ContentBasedDeduplication=true. Subscriber: Lambda function "payment-handler". SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TOPIC: payment-events.fifo
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Topic type — FIFO (ordering + dedup, 300 TPS)
  [✗]      Subscriptions — Lambda is NOT supported on FIFO topics. FIFO topics only support SQS FIFO queue subscribers. Use a FIFO topic → SQS FIFO queue → Lambda (event source mapping) pattern.
  [✓]      ContentBasedDeduplication — true
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sns create-topic --name payment-events.fifo --attributes FifoTopic=true

eval_cases.name: Cross-account SQS subscriber with AWS-managed key — decrypt will fail
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — AWS-managed key blocks cross-account decryption
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production SNS topic named "shared-events" in us-east-1. SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key (alias/aws/sns). Subscriber: SQS queue in account 222222222222 ("arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:222222222222:partner-queue"). Enable delivery status logging. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TOPIC: shared-events
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Topic type — Standard
  [✗]      Encryption — AWS-managed key (alias/aws/sns) blocks cross-account decryption. Switch to a customer-managed CMK whose policy grants account 222222222222 kms:Decrypt + kms:GenerateDataKey*.
  [✓]      Subscriptions — cross-account SQS (222222222222:partner-queue)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/aws/sns --policy-name default

eval_cases.name: HTTPS subscription with no delivery status logging — silent message loss risk
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — HTTP subscriptions require delivery failure logging
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production SNS topic named "webhook-delivery" in us-east-1. Subscriber: HTTPS endpoint https://api.partner.com/webhook. SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key. No delivery status logging configured. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TOPIC: webhook-delivery
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Topic type — Standard
  [✓]      Subscriptions — HTTPS (https://api.partner.com/webhook)
  [✗]      Delivery logging — HTTPFailureFeedbackRoleArn is NOT set. SNS retries HTTP for 4 hours then silently drops messages. Without failure logging, dropped messages are invisible.
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:webhook-delivery --query 'Attributes.HTTPFailureFeedbackRoleArn'

eval_cases.name: FIFO topic with SQS FIFO subscriber, dedup, delivery logging
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — FIFO topic with correct SQS FIFO subscriber
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a production FIFO SNS topic named "transaction-events.fifo" in us-east-1. ContentBasedDeduplication=true. Subscriber: SQS FIFO queue "transaction-queue.fifo" (same account). Enable SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key. Enable SQS delivery status logging. maxReceiveCount on the SQS queue is 10. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TOPIC: transaction-events.fifo
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Topic type — FIFO (ordering + dedup, 300 TPS)
  [✓]      ContentBasedDeduplication — true
  [✓]      Encryption — SSE-KMS (alias/aws/sns, same-account)
  [✓]      Subscriptions — SQS FIFO (transaction-queue.fifo, same account)
  [✓]      Delivery logging — SQS failure (role: SNSDeliveryFeedback)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:transaction-events.fifo
  aws sns list-subscriptions-by-topic --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:transaction-events.fifo
  aws sns publish --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:transaction-events.fifo --message '{"test": true}' --message-group-id test-group
